questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes “electronegativity”?

options.label: A
options.text: The intrinsic ability of a bonded atom to attract shared electron density toward itself in a covalent bond.

options.label: B
options.text: A chemical species capable of donating a proton (hydrogen ion, H+) to a base.

options.label: C
options.text: A chemical species possessing a nonbonding electron pair that acts as an electron-pair donor (nucleophile).

options.label: D
options.text: A quantitative vector measure of net molecular charge separation, equal to the magnitude of charge multiplied by distance.

questions.correct_answer: The intrinsic ability of a bonded atom to attract shared electron density toward itself in a covalent bond.
questions.explanation: A accurate description of electronegativity is: The intrinsic ability of a bonded atom to attract shared electron density toward itself in a covalent bond.
